name: imgbotconfig

schedule.title: Limits the PRs from Imgbot to once a day, once a week, or once a month respectively. The default behavior is to receive Imgbot PRs as images require optimization.

ignoredFiles.title: Limits the images optimized by Imgbot by essentially ignoring them

items.title: Accepts the syntax for searchPattern on Directory.EnumerateFiles()

aggressiveCompression.title: Opt in to use lossy compression algorithms. The default behaviour without this setting is loss less compression.

compressWiki.title: Opt in to also compress wiki repo. The default behaviour is opt out.

minKBReduced.title: Can be used to limit the frequency of PRs Imgbot will open over time

schema.title: JSON Schema for configuration for ImgBot

description:
The Imgbot setup is scheduled to run on a weekly basis, so pull‑request updates will be generated once per week. Images located under `assets/images/`, the specific screenshot at `docs/screenshots/example.png`, and the icon file `/static/icons/icon.svg` are excluded from any optimization work.

Lossy (aggressive) compression is enabled for the remaining assets, while the wiki repository is left untouched. A pull request will only be opened when the proposed changes reduce the file size by at least 15 KB.
